abilities.name: Early Whistle
abilities.effect: Everyone backs off and gives space. Nobody says "calm down." Playing this early never gets you in trouble.

attacks.name: Let Off Steam
attacks.effect: Five big slow breaths, like blowing out birthday candles.

attacks.name: Cool Down
attacks.effect: Take a 5-minute break somewhere quiet. Grown-ups always say yes to this one.

art.caption: Play it at Warm, not at Volcano

abilities.name: Spot the Hook
abilities.effect: Whatever is winding me up stops now, even if you didn't mean it that way. You don't have to agree. You just stop.

attacks.name: Don't Bite
attacks.effect: Walk away from the lure. Bait only works if you bite.

attacks.name: Name It
attacks.effect: Say it calmly: "That's winding me up." Not "you're trying to make me mad."

art.caption: What you're doing is winding me up

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.effect: Everyone turns the volume down, backs up a step, and stops asking questions.

attacks.name: Unplug
attacks.effect: Headphones on, or go somewhere quiet.

attacks.name: Ground Out
attacks.effect: Lie under something heavy, like a blanket or pillows, until the sparks stop.

art.caption: Too loud, too close, too many things

abilities.name: Wrong Target Shield
abilities.effect: This mad isn't for you, so don't take it personally. Anyone can hold this card up as a question: "Is this a Grumblock?"

attacks.name: Point It Out
attacks.effect: Point at the thing you're actually mad at.

attacks.name: Call a Teammate
attacks.effect: Ask someone to help with the stuck thing.

art.caption: I'm mad at a thing, not at you

abilities.name: Hear Me Out
abilities.effect: You get one calm sentence, and a grown-up has to listen to the whole thing. One sentence, not the whole trial.

attacks.name: State Your Case
attacks.effect: Say what happened in one calm sentence.

attacks.name: Take Turns
attacks.effect: Set a timer so everybody gets a fair go.

art.caption: Play when the rules feel broken

abilities.name: Shell Up
abilities.effect: Nobody follows you, talks to you, or bugs you while this card is out. Retreat pauses things, it doesn't cancel them. Chores and consequences are still waiting when you come back.

attacks.name: Hide Out
attacks.effect: Go to your safe spot. Pick it ahead of time.

attacks.name: Come Back Out
attacks.effect: When you're ready, come back and flip this card face-down.

art.caption: I need space. Don't follow me

abilities.name: Final Whistle
abilities.effect: The rough stuff stops the second this card is shown. No "one more time." The other player asks, "Are you okay?" Not for quitting a game you're losing. That's a Shellter.

attacks.name: Say It
attacks.effect: Say what has to stop: "No more tickling."

abilities.name: Fresh Start
abilities.effect: A truce takes both players. Once the other player bumps fists, the fight is over and neither of you brings it back up. Grown-ups can still talk about it later.

attacks.name: Shake On It
attacks.effect: Offer a high five, fist bump, or pinky shake. The other player is allowed to say "not yet."

attacks.name: New Game
attacks.effect: Pick something fun to do together.

art.caption: I'm okay now. Are we good?
